notes.title: ♥ TERRORHYTHM ⚡ FULL RELEASE ⚡ TODAY ♥
notes.content:

It will be available today in a few hours!

It has been a long time since our Early Access release for TERRORHYTHM (TRRT).
Our team visited some game events where you could find us and play the game. You shared helpful feedback with us for productive and effective development.

[h1][b][u]Thanks for all your support![/u][/b][/h1]

[b]Save 25% by buying 2-in-1![/b]

[h1][b]So, get ready to start TERRORHYTHM![/b][/h1]

[i]Here is a list of major updates and changes during development:[/i]
[list]
[*][i]The character progression system and unlocking content by rank was added[/i]
[*][i]Added more battle scenes and new levels in the campaign mode[/i]
[*][i]4 levels of difficulty were introduced - Relax, Simple, Hard and Terror.[/i]
[*][i]New mobs were added: a mob kamikaze called "Fast" (moves much faster than others enemies), armored and shielded mobs. Boss-fighting mechanics was implemented.[/i]
[*][i]Weapons: Throwing (The Chakram disc) and melee were updated. As well as charging and extra hit zone mechanics[/i]
[*][i]We've added the Leaderboards. So, now you can see the other players' scores, your position among all players and the Top-3 rating for every level;[/i]
[*][i]Improved algorithm for analyzing your own tracks in a Custom Game.[/i]
[*][i]Every uploaded track at Custom Game will be saved to your tracklist and you'll need just to choose from menu any of them to play again;[/i]
[*][i]Added more new music tracks[/i]
[*][i]Partial controller support was added (you can setup the control keys)[/i]
[*][i]Enabled new Steam achievements. All achievements are available now.[/i]
[*][i]English, Russian, French, Italian, German and Spanish localization were done as well.[/i]
[/list]
[i]Unfortunately, the Steam community items (trading cards, badges, emoticons, backgrounds that we have prepared and uploaded) are still not available. This is a problem on Steam side. We hope that they will be approved and enabled very soon![/i]

notes.title: New v0.3.0106: Custom Game mode update and more
We launch the 1st TRRT Tournament!
notes.content:
Hey!
Today is the last day of spring and our team decided to start the summer with something new. So, we would like to introduce you with [u]the 1st TRRT Tournament[/u]!

We'll choose some great song of a popular artist and invite you to achieve the best game score to this track. 

This week ([u]1-7 June[/u]) we are playing TRRT to the [b]Imagine Dragons hit 'Believer'[/b]. 
To all masters of their seas: upload the song to Custom Game mode, record a video of playing through the level, and throw us a link! 
We will send a prize key for our previous game 'Star Story: The Horizon Escape' to the best player next week. 
Link to original clip where you can download this amazing song: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wtfhZwyrcc

And what will be yours? Try your best!
GL HF

notes.title: The new update v.0.2.1805 is ready to play!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/805d00e64942f3bcbbe3b12bce4a2a9025ad931a.jpg[/img]

Dear friends, we’re declaring that we wouldn’t stop at the field of making our game better! Many thanks to our game’ players who are helping us to mark some details we can fix. So meet TRRT v.0.2.1805.

[h1][b]The character progression system was added[/b][/h1]
Each new player has rank 1. To increase the rank, the player needs to gain the experience points (XPs) for passing the campaign levels and also playing in custom mode.
[b]Getting XP during the campaign mode[/b]
Player gets a certain number of XP for each campaign level he passed (as in the case of victory, so in case of defeat).
Amount of accumulated EXs is specified by the difficulty settings of the level. 
The player doesn’t receive any XPs for playing on the Relax difficulty. 
The player gets the certain amount of accumulated XP on the standard difficulty level.
 For the passage on the raised complexity levels the player receives more XPs: х1.2 on Hard, х1.5 on Terror difficulty level.
The player gets an XPs even if he loses the level (or exits) according to the following multiplier scheme:

[i]from 0 to 30 seconds playing time	    0[/i]
[i]from 30 to 60 seconds playing time	x 0.1 [/i]
[i]from 60 to 120 seconds playing time	x 0.2[/i]
[i]More than 120 seconds playing time	x 0.4[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/d66281a657234ea31f88c6f7399bfd3e86e4e782.jpg[/img]
[b]Getting XP during the custom tracks mode[/b]
An XPs in custom track mode accrue for the playing time (doesn’t matter if you lose/exit or win) on the standard difficulty level by following system:

[i]from 0 to 30 seconds playing time	     +0 XPs[/i]
[i]from 30 to 60 seconds playing time	+10 XPs[/i]
[i]from 60 to 120 seconds playing time	+20 XPs[/i]
[i]from 120 to 180 seconds playing time	+30 XPs[/i]
[i]from 180 to 240 seconds playing time	+40 XPs[/i]
[i]from 240 to 300 seconds playing time	+50 XPs[/i]
[i]More than 300 seconds playing time	+60 XPs[/i]

The player doesn’t receive any XPs for playing on the Relax difficulty. 
For playing on the raised difficulties levels the player receives more XPs, using the multipliers: х1.2 on Hard, х1.5 on Terror difficulty level.
[b]Lock content by rank[/b]
The levels in the campaign are blocked relatively the rank. That is, a player can play the level only if his rank is equal to or higher than the rank that is required to unlock this level.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/126241869e6a7131dd871a049af9acdb0980d065.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]The mobs generating system was fixed[/b][/h1]
So the cases of getting the guaranteed damage due to an incorrect sequence of enemies’ generation are excluded 
[h1]
[/h1]
[h1][b]Some fixes in UI was done[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Another week passed - Another update (v 0.2.2004) was done!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/81c764a10079a0c2e6f86eb40c9d573bab745d6f.jpg[/img]

Greetings, friends!
Today it's Friday and it means that the long-awaited weekend is ahead, and we would like to report on the work done during this week. In practice, you can get acquainted with the results of our work by updating TERRORHYTHM to version 0.2.2004, which is available from today!
So, what have we done:
- Problems with damage to the enemy "jumper" ("shifter") were identified and corrected.
- Now you can see the number of remaining hits of the used weapon
- Improved animation effects of combat, charging and expansion of the strike zone
- Added animated effects of the appearance of enemies 
- Added two new music tracks
- Added three new levels in the campaign mode
- Improved readability of health level
- Improved interface of arena' selection
- Level completion' interface and results view are updated 
- Pause window interface is updated
- Some localization issues are fixed

We wish you all a pleasant weekend!
And a little video gameplay to make the mood even better:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JZ83p8_ngFA&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: v0.2.1304 is coming! Game balance + Achievements
notes.content:
We hasten to announce the second update, just after the first one, which we've uploaded yesterday. Now the game process will be much more comfortable!

[h1]v0.2.1304:[/h1]

- We fixed some major issues with the game balance, such as spawning too many enemies and dumb scenarios like when you just can`t kill all enemies without taking damage.
- Learning curve became more smooth, so playing with your own music in the custom mode is more comfortable now. 
It's still very hard to finish some levels in Terror difficulty mode, so we are waiting for you in Leaderboards!
- Added new music track for the campaign mode (Level 2).
- Enabled the achievements "X points" (Earn X points in a round) where X is from 1000 to 50k.
- New achievements for killing bosses, jumpers and heavy enemies more than 1000 times are available.

We once again want to thank all the players who send us their comments and feedback on which we continue to work hard. The result of this work will not take long to wait with the new updates!
Nice weekend to all!

notes.title: Update to v0.2.0 is available. Stability + FPS improvements
notes.content:
[b]Build v0.2.0 is now live![/b] 
It is a huge update, so we could change the version number. 
The major fixes today fixed many optimization issues and problems with low FPS, game crashes and input lags which were annoying while playing. We'd like to thank everyone who has taken the time to let us know about this and helped us locate it. You guys are awesome!

The full changelog is below!

[h1]Build v0.2.0[/h1] 

- Finished with game code and assets optimization (much less resources are required to play)
- Fixed stability and framerate drop issues
- Fixed game crashes in some modes
- Fixed some weird desync issues with the game.
- Fixed memory leaks when you load your track
- Fixed window is winding down when you load your track
- The default language is set to English on start. 
- New music upload UI


Known issues for next updates
- The enemies could run in place and never move
- Sometimes you still couldn't attack the enemies

if you have any issues, do let us know how to reproduce it and contact us via the Steam Discussions or support@evilcg.com

notes.title: Today is TERRORHYTHM Out Day!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/f9544c2188aa73d1253d7bfe35209b13d6a32a6c.jpg[/img]

Dear friends!
[b]Now we're excited to confirm, that TERRORHYTHM finally will be available today in a few hours! [/b]

[i]As you could notice, we had a little delay the release since last week. That's why we decided to launch with 25% discount. So, you will get the best price if you buy the game at the first week![/i]

This week was the most nervous for our team, but in spite of all difficulties, we managed to do:
[list]
    [*]A lot of work was done to optimize the game and its work stability. We assume that we have not been able to solve ALL the problems with this, so we urge you to cooperate and look forward to your feedback on this in a special forum thread https://steamcommunity.com/app/752380/discussions/0/1694917906659022721/
    [*]Combinations of mob's spawn were under detailed polishing;
    [*]Also, we've added more than 30 achievements and its quantity will only increase;
    [*]We have prepared and uploaded the community items: trading cards, badges, emoticons, which will be available as soon as Steam will approve it;
    [*]Especially for Apple users, we've prepared a Mac version of TERRORHYTHM. For now, it's only the campaign mode is available for this version. The full custom mode will be available the very soon next updates;
    [*]English, Russian, French, Italian, German and Spanish localization was done as well. 

Can you help us to translate TERRORHYTHM? You can join our POEditor Community translation project. For more info, follow the link 
http://terrorhythm-trrt.wikia.com/wiki/Community_translation_project_of_TERRORHYTHM
[/list]
So, get ready to start TERRORHYTHM and to have a new gaming experience!

notes.title: With weapons in hand
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31272526/0432782253c6c6a06cb6adde2ee38c1c406c365b.jpg[/img]

Have you already noticed the katana in the hands of the main character? But this is not the only weapon, which will be used by him.
The weapons drop out of the mobs during the battle. A player picks up the weapon when his standard attack kills an enemy that has a weapon.
For now, we have 3 types:
-  Swords when used widen the attack zone to the maximum.
-  Bludgeons when used push off all enemies from your punch side.
-  With a throwing weapon, the player kills the enemy at any distance.
